test_ingredient_config: test that an Ingredient config decorator registers a ConfigScope with key-value pairs
test_ingredient_captured_functions: test that an Ingredient capture decorator registers a captured function accessible by name
test_ingredient_command: test that an Ingredient command decorator registers a runnable command with config parameters

test_double_nested_config: test that nested Ingredients propagate config scopes through multiple levels of hierarchy
